game_updates.title: Apex Legends: Anti-Cheat Update - 09/10/2026
game_updates.contents: We’re happy to share an update in Apex’s fight against cheaters and cheat makers. Following our engagement, Collective Minds (creators of the Cronus Zen and Strike Pack hardware devices) has removed all cheats relating to Apex Legends from their website and Discord servers.This is a positive step for our team and the future of Apex Legends as we work to establish and maintain the highest standard of competitive integrity possible. For more details please read the official EA Blog, here.

game_updates.title: Yet Another Update 1.0.1
game_updates.contents: ㅤWelcome, Survivor! We're releasing an update with new features, requested changes, and fixes for some of the remaining issues reported since version 1.0.0c2. Other platforms will follow ASAP. The changes are as follows: Additions: A "pity system" was introduced to counter the cases of bad luck when it comes to rolling items required by the current mission (every roll without the item increases the chance of it appearing). Added "Zombie Volume" setting in the Options -> Audio. Added an automatic "Liberate" option to the "Auto-Selection" menu. "Run History" view now displays how much damage of each type has been dealt. game_updates.title: Surviving Mars: Relaunched - What's New Since Release
game_updates.contents: Hello Commanders,When Surviving Mars: Relaunched went live last November, we mentioned that it was the launch pad for a new era of Surviving Mars, with more to explore down the line. Tomorrow, we drop a free update that rebuilds two of the systems sitting closest to the heart of the game, alongside the first part of our Prime Mission - the content pack Feeding the Future. Before we get to what's coming, it's worth taking a note of what's already here. If you last visited Mars around launch, the colony you'd land in today is a noticeably different place, and a lot of that is down to the reports, saves, and forum threads you've sent our way. Below are some highlights of what’s happened in the last few months, and if you want to get into the nitty-gritty details, check out the full patch note...
